prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1047; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Houston, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had been waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic and had my signal on before I started to move. The impact threw me against the door and my left wrist hit the armrest, and I felt immediate pain. I was taken to hospital, where an X-ray showed a fracture to my wrist, and I have been wearing a splint since. I have described the collision the same way every time I have spoken about it, to the police officer at the scene, to the medical staff, and to the adjuster who called me. I am the household member of the policyholder, and I live in the same home, so I am submitting this claim as a covered driver under the policy.
